exceptions.state: SKIPPED IN CI — PERMANENT AND CORRECT
exceptions.reason: Requires a populated .env. .env is git-ignored and must never be committed; secret_protection is a global non-waivable invariant. CI therefore cannot have one.
exceptions.compensating: Runs and passes on the owner's machine, where .env exists. Owner execution recorded at Step 108.
exceptions.expiry: none — this is a permanent property of the split between CI and local environments, not a temporary waiver

exceptions.state: SKIPPED IN CI — PERMANENT AND CORRECT
exceptions.reason: Requires both a populated .env and a reachable local SQL Server instance. Neither exists on a GitHub-hosted runner.
exceptions.compensating: Runs on the owner's machine. This is the evidence for Step 108.
exceptions.expiry: none — permanent property of the environment split

exceptions.state: SKIPPED IN CI by marker local_env
exceptions.reason: ODBC Driver 18 is a local machine prerequisite. The runner installs unixODBC only, not the Microsoft driver.
exceptions.compensating: Verified on the owner's machine — pyodbc.drivers() lists 'ODBC Driver 18 for SQL Server'.

testBaseline.honestyNote: These are recorded as exceptions because canonical Step 107 requires it, not because they are defects. A skip that is expected, explained and compensated is a valid exception. A skip that is merely unexamined is not.

defectsFound.defect: Reported '.env file committed' whenever a .env existed on disk, without asking git whether it was tracked. Step 108 requires a local .env, so performing Step 108 would have made this check fail permanently on the owner's machine on a false claim.
defectsFound.fix: Ask git ls-files whether the path is tracked. Fail-closed if git cannot answer.
defectsFound.negativeTest: untracked .env PASS; force-added .env FAIL; unstaged PASS; planted credential FAIL

defectsFound.defect: Same class. Flagged '.env' as a disallowed root file on presence alone. The check exists to catch files COMMITTED to the wrong place; an untracked local file is not that.
defectsFound.fix: Skip untracked files in the root scan. Fail-closed if git cannot answer.
defectsFound.negativeTest: untracked .env PASS; tracked stray file FAIL; untracked stray PASS; governance artifact at root FAIL; clean PASS

defectsFound.commonCause: Both checks inspected the filesystem when they meant to inspect the repository. A check that fails on a legitimate state trains the reader to disregard it, and a disregarded check is no check at all. Neither would have surfaced in CI, which never has a .env — they were latent, and only performing Step 108 would have exposed them.
